digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify test infrastructure and ADR documentation
propositions: Gerrit Verify currently runs complete real-Pandoc subprocess conversions over the DC wiki corpus, consuming 184+ seconds of critical path time.
ADR 0095 mandates real Pandoc binary for every conversion assertion; moving corpus replay to external integration requires a narrow superseding ADR decision.
The design preserves three representative live corpus bodies and compact probes in Gerrit Verify while relocating complete replay to dedicated external-integration.yml job.
External-integration.yml currently supports only Ubuntu; the implementation must add a pandoc-corpus-replay matrix with ubuntu-latest and macos-latest arms.
Deterministic fixture regeneration and platform-specific binary fingerprint verification must remain documented and available.
Paired A/B implementation evidence is required to confirm the actual performance improvement beyond the 184.32-second lower-bound estimate.
